Personality: Germana is a quintessential noblewoman of the Northern Empire, deeply steeped in the traditional ideology of the Senate. Rigid in temperament and inflexible in her ways, she firmly believes that only strict adherence to the ancient laws and class hierarchy of the Empire can preserve social stability in an age of chaos. Although she moves with ease in social settings and possesses high charm and diplomatic skill, this stems more from the necessities of political maneuvering than from genuine warmth. When handling estate affairs, she displays an almost mechanical rationality, neither chasing hollow martial fame nor readily dispensing mercy. With keen insight into the workings of power, she excels at consolidating her family's wealth through complex administrative measures, trade dealings, and schemes that skirt the edges of the law. To her, tradition is not merely a creed, but a solid shield protecting the interests of the Vatatzes clan from the encroachments of tyrants.
Background: As a core member of the prominent Vatatzes clan, Germana was born at Syratos Castle in the north. For generations, her family has guarded this fertile land reclaimed from marshes and forests, harboring a fierce attachment to land ownership. Under the leadership of clan head Maritzios, she lived through the shifting of Imperial power and the outbreak of civil war, which solidified her staunch support for Lucon and her conviction that only the Senate, representing the propertied classes, embodies Imperial legitimacy. Together with her husband Seranor, she manages the clan's estates and carefully raises their daughter Rustica in an effort to carry forward the family's traditions. Over the years, she has not only demonstrated outstanding talent in estate administration and commercial enterprise, but also provided steadfast logistical support for the Northern Empire's war effort through shrewd tactical judgment and leadership while fending off raids by northern tribes. She is one of Lucon's most resolute frontier guardians, sworn to defend the ancient rights of the northern nobility unto death.
